'''Blowfin''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Puffbelly]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies.

==Overview==
Current Description: "When emotions get out of control, Blowfin turns into a ball. Hates it when [[Cactobud]] is up to no good."

Blowfin is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Blowfin's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Puffbelly]] you need to complete the following task:

* Craft 3 Bento(s) at the Bento Maker. Become a master chef!
